en.title: The Brass Melody and the Amber Dawn
en.premise: In a sleepless city where steam engines hum endlessly, a group of friends living in an old apartment block find themselves drawn into subtle mysteries—like a missing key and a midnight melody. Rather than chasing suspects, they gently investigate why these enigmas appear, in a warm ensemble mystery.

zh.title: 真鍮的音色与琥珀色的黎明
zh.premise: 在一座永不安眠、蒸汽机轰鸣不息的城市里，一群以绰号互相称呼的朋友住在一座老旧的集合住宅里。某一天，像“失踪的钥匙”“午夜旋律”这样的小谜团悄然闯入他们的日常。故事不追逐谁，而是温柔地探寻这些谜团为何出现，呈现一部温暖的群像剧悬疑。
